text_en: General Brigard's being too much of a pessimist, if you ask me.
The Lion of Dadelm turning up here is a good omen.
You know, cut off the serpent's head and its body'll die too
What?_300_ What do you mean it doesn't work like that?
Either way, the mangy cat's still around._100_ He'll be waiting for the slightest chance to pounce on us.
